backgrounds.name: Ferry Hand
backgrounds.description: Years hauling the ferry rope across the Brindle in flood and fog.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Every ferry crew in the vale knows your face.

backgrounds.name: Hive Novice
backgrounds.description: Raised among the Hive Sisters; you know your herbs and your manners.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: The Sisters treat you as family.

backgrounds.name: Dockside Runner
backgrounds.description: Carried messages, and sometimes other people's purses, along the Saltreed docks.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Smugglers assume you are one of them.
